SOV3's own substrate code and governance layer are CSOAI's IP. The base models it wraps are individually permissively licensed (Apache-2.0 / MIT — see table above); no copyleft (AGPL/GPL) component is used in the paid/sovereign tier, by design — copyleft dependencies are quarantined to the fully-open free tier only, to avoid forcing the commercial stack open.
